dedupe_keys.name: arpce algeria quarterly market observatories fixed mobile and internet subscribers technologies and consumed bandwidth

description: The Algerian Regulatory Authority for Post and Electronic Communications publishes quarterly market observatories for fixed telephony, mobile telephony, internet and postal services. The internet observatory gives the subscriber base by access type: ADSL, fixed 4G LTE, FTTH fibre and leased lines for fixed internet, and active 3G and 4G mobile internet subscribers, together with the growth of the total base over five quarters and the total international bandwidth consumed in Gbps. For the third quarter of 2025 it lists about 6.8 million fixed internet subscribers, of which 2.6 million on FTTH, 53.6 million active mobile internet subscribers, and consumed bandwidth of 5,260 Gbps. The mobile and fixed observatories give subscribers and market shares by operator (Mobilis, Djezzy and Ooredoo for mobile, Algérie Télécom for fixed). Each observatory can be downloaded as a document. Coverage: Algeria, national totals by quarter. Format and access: web pages with downloadable observatory reports, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: national totals only; active subscriber definitions follow an ARPCE decision of February 2020; the archive start was not checked. Simulation uses: national demand, technology mix and international bandwidth growth for Algerian telecom and backbone capacity models. Related records: the ITU ICT statistics give comparable series; the TeleGeography submarine cable map covers Algeria's Mediterranean landings.
